Game types on the main menu: Marathon, Ultra and VS Tetris
Piece types in the game data: Fusion (atom pieces), Square (gold/silver squares) and Sticky (star pieces) variants, plus Popular

Next queue and the Hold slot

Level goals per mode
Worlds (Water, Fire, Air, Forest, Mountain, Snow) are the backdrops; levels speed up the fall
